description: Send one email from ShearQuery to one contact, in their conversation thread — by conversation_id, or contact_id to start or continue that contact's thread. Replies come back into the same thread. A reply can leave out subject (it reuses the thread's, with Re:). Read the exact message back to the owner and get their OK first: it can't be unsent. Refused for a contact with no email or marked do-not-contact. channel is email; texting isn't connected yet.

body.description: Plain text, exactly as approved. Blank lines become paragraphs.

name: crm_send_message
title: Send an email to a contact
